notes: ART mission 10-109. Parent-opened Powder/AP account (2026-09-16): ~1 p.m. Sunday 2010-12-05 avalanche in the Dry Gulch area near I-70 and US 6, Clear Creek County; two backcountry skiers buried — Kyle Shellberg, 32, of Golden, killed (pronounced dead at scene); Justin Latici, 31, of Golden, injured (leg injury; dug himself out and performed CPR on Shellberg). Slide ~15 ft deep, 500 ft wide, ran ~200 yards. Alpine Rescue Team responded (Bill Barwick quoted). Outcome corrected run 679 (was injury/1 victim, assumed from Code 3 avalanche response).
